summary: Updated implementation plan for SC-200 Exam Gym incorporating Section 18: Critical Reliability, Privacy and Learning Improvements, including evidence-based answer verification with structured Microsoft Learn citations, private non-public PDF storage and processing disclosures, separate extraction vs. verification confidence tracking, deeper KQL technical learning with simulated output labels and table schemas, post-answer confidence tracking (Guessed/Unsure/Confident) with spaced repetition, honest first-attempt readiness modeling, and the 5-phase implementation and acceptance gates.
